name: Douglas T. Cohen
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Northglenn, Colorado
education: University of Missouri School of Law (Columbia)
about: The founder of Peak Legal LLC, Douglas T. Cohen is a former Colorado prosecutor and, therefore, knows how prosecutors think and assess defendants. He has been licensed in good standing for 30 years.

Attorney Cohen focuses his practice on criminal defense, more recently specializing in sex crimes and sex offenses and limiting his clientele by accepting only a very select number of clients to devote extensive attention to their cases. He provides effective and aggressive advocacy for clients throughout the state of Colorado from the firm’s offices in Denver and Northglenn.

He has represented clients in high-level sex offense and sex crime cases throughout Colorado's Front Range, Mountain region and Western Slope. This includes such cases in Adams, Arapahoe, Arvada, Aspen, Aurora, Boulder, Brighton, Broomfield, Castlerock, Centennial. Colorado Springs, Cortez, Denver, Glenwood Springs, Fort Collins,Greeley, Lakewood, Montrose, Sterling, and many other cities and counties.
Mr. Cohen’s also has represented clients charged with murder, sex offenses, DUI, vehicular homicide, drug offenses and other criminal defense.
In the recent past he obtained a deferred misdemeanor plea in a major felony case, allowing the client to have the case dismissed after a short probation period instead of facing lengthy prison.
He also obtained total dismissal in a First Degree Murder case in Denver and a plea to a misdemeanor in a DF1-Special Offender Drug case.
Prior to founding his current firm, Mr. Cohen spent over 12 years as a prosecutor in Colorado’s 1st and 4th Judicial Districts, including serving in the sex crimes and family violence units.

His track record of obtaining favorable and reasonable plea bargains as well as acquittals and dismissals reflects his experience working on both sides of the justice system. It has led to Mr. Cohen’s receipt of a 10.0 “Superb” peer review rating through Avvo along with his being named to The National Trial Lawyers: Top 100.

Mr. Cohen majored in journalism as an undergraduate at Northwestern University and received a Bachelor of Arts in 1986. After spending several years as an investigative and general assignment reporter, he attended the University of Missouri School of Law, and he was inducted into the Order of Barristers before being awarded his Juris Doctor in 1996.
